_doc._about: Defaults for scripts/kicad_schrules.py. A project copies this file, keeps only the keys it changes, and passes it with --rules. Keys starting with an underscore are ignored. Unknown keys are an error, so a typo cannot silently disable a check.
_doc.prefixes: Regexes matched against the whole reference prefix (the letters before the first digit, so LED13 gives LED). C[A-Z]* covers C, CB and CF; R covers R only. A key may also be a list of regexes.
_doc.prefixes.capacitor: Reference prefix of capacitors. Every capacitance lookup uses it.
_doc.prefixes.resistor: Reference prefix of resistors. Series resistor and pull-up lookups use it.
_doc.prefixes.diode: Reference prefix of diodes. A diode on a connector net counts as protection when its value or library part matches patterns.tvs_value.
_doc.patterns: Regexes searched (not anchored unless they say so) in net names and pin names. A net named /sheet/SDA is matched by its last path segment, SDA.
_doc.patterns.ground_net: Net names that are ground. Power symbols are not components in the netlist, so ground is recognised by name only.
_doc.patterns.ground_pin: Pin names that are ground. A power_in pin with one of these names is not a supply pin.
_doc.patterns.power_net: Net names that are supply rails. A net also counts as a rail when a power_out pin or a non-ground power_in pin is on it.
_doc.patterns.addressable_led: Matched against an LED's value, footprint and library part name. Selects the addressable LED parts.
_doc.patterns.led_data_in_pin: Pin names of an addressable LED data input.
_doc.patterns.led_data_out_pin: Pin names of an addressable LED data output. Used to find the first LED of a chain.
_doc.patterns.open_drain: Net names and pin names that need a pull-up: I2C and reset. A bare RST is not matched; widen this pattern to include it for a board with a bare microcontroller.
_doc.patterns.vin_net: Net names that bring power in from a connector. Also excluded from bulk_capacitance discovery, because a raw input is the connector rule's job (electronics.md section 6).
_doc.patterns.tvs_value: Matched against a diode's value and library part name. Selects the transient suppressor diodes.
_doc.rules: One object per rule. Every rule takes enabled, severity (error or warning) and waive.
_doc.rules.*.enabled: false skips the rule and says so in the output.
_doc.rules.*.severity: error makes the finding fail the gate (exit 1). warning is reported and exits 0.
_doc.rules.*.waive: List of {"match": REGEX, "reason": TEXT}. A finding is waived when the regex matches any symbol reference or net name it names. The reason is required. A waived finding is listed, with its reason, and does not count. This is the rejection table of electronics.md section 6 in machine form: write a waiver where the design decided against the part, never to quiet a finding.
_doc.rules.decoupling_present: Every power pin of an IC has a capacitor to ground on its net. A net-level check: it cannot see placement, and one capacitor on a rail satisfies every pin on that rail.
_doc.rules.decoupling_present.prefixes: Reference prefixes of the parts whose power pins are checked.
_doc.rules.decoupling_present.led_prefixes: Reference prefixes of LEDs. Only addressable LEDs (patterns.addressable_led) are checked, and only the pins named by led_power_pin_names.
_doc.rules.decoupling_present.led_power_pin_n: Regex for an LED's supply pin names.
_doc.rules.decoupling_present.power_pin_types: Pin electrical types that count as a power input.
_doc.rules.bulk_capacitance: Each supply rail carries at least min_farads of capacitance to ground, summed over every capacitor from the rail to ground.
_doc.rules.bulk_capacitance.nets: Explicit rail names. When non-empty it replaces discovery. A name absent from the netlist is a finding.
_doc.rules.bulk_capacitance.net_pattern: Rails found by name when nets is empty.
_doc.rules.bulk_capacitance.include_power_out: Also check any net driven by a power_out pin.
_doc.rules.bulk_capacitance.include_power_in_: Also check any net that feeds a non-ground power_in pin, except nets matching patterns.vin_net.
_doc.rules.bulk_capacitance.min_farads: Minimum total capacitance in farads. A string with a unit is accepted: 4u7, 10uF.
_doc.rules.led_data_series_resistor: The first addressable LED of a chain has a resistor between its data input and the driver. A resistor to ground or to a supply does not count.
_doc.rules.led_data_series_resistor.driver_pr: Reference prefixes of the parts that may drive the data line. The far side of the resistor must reach a signal pin of one of them.
_doc.rules.open_drain_pullups: Each net matching patterns.open_drain has a resistor to a supply rail with a value inside its class's window. A fixed window per class, not the UM10204 rise-time window, which needs the bus capacitance (references/domains.md 3.8).
_doc.rules.open_drain_pullups.classes: {name: {match, min_ohms, max_ohms}}. A net takes the first class, in name order, whose match regex hits its name or a pin name on it. Defaults: i2c 1 k to 10 k, reset 4.7 k to 100 k. A project that changes one class restates the whole classes object.
_doc.rules.open_drain_pullups.min_ohms: Lowest accepted pull-up value, in ohms, for a net no class matches.
_doc.rules.open_drain_pullups.max_ohms: Highest accepted pull-up value, in ohms, for a net no class matches.
_doc.rules.connector_input_protection: Each connector pin on a patterns.vin_net net has a fuse, a series inductor or bead, or a TVS diode on that net. A warning by default, because a module often carries the protection.
_doc.rules.connector_input_protection.series_: Reference prefixes of series inductors and beads.
_doc.rules.connector_input_protection.tvs_pre: Reference prefixes of parts that may be a TVS, in addition to prefixes.diode. Matched with patterns.tvs_value.
